research_rationale:
EO 12310 (President's Commission on Housing), signed 1981-06-16. The order establishes the President's Commission on Housing of not more than twenty-two members (Section 1), its function of advising on national housing policy (Section 2), administration (Section 3) and general provisions (Section 4). Section 4(b) ends the Commission when it presents its final report and recommendations, which is report-relative and not a dated end. EO 12339 later raised the membership ceiling to thirty. First end: Section 4(g) of EO 12399 (Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees, signed 1982-12-31, 48 FR 379) names Executive Order No. 12310 among the orders revoked, and Section 6 makes that order effective December 31, 1982, so the revocation took effect on 1982-12-31. The same section describes the listed orders as ones that established committees which have terminated or whose work is completed; that recital is disclosed as context and as a possible earlier cessation, but it gives no date and is not an end.
